_note: English source strings; keys are shared with fr.json.
page.title: Luxembourgish voice tutor
notice.ai: You are talking to an AI tutor, not a person. The voices are computer-generated, and the Luxembourgish can contain mistakes.
data.note: Everything the app keeps about you stays on this PC: the phrases you met, every practice answer you confirm with its recording and what the tutor said to it, and your reviews.
progress.note: Minutes count the recordings whose length the app keeps; until it keeps them for every answer, this can stay at 0 min.
voice.talk_toggle: Press once to talk, press again to stop
practice.realistic: Realistic - a 10-minute clock runs while you talk
practice.clock_over: The ten minutes of the real talk are over - carry on as long as you like.
practice.footnote: Not affiliated with INLL. Questions and corrections are not reviewed by a native speaker.
listening.intro: Listen to a short recording at 1x or 0.75x, as often as you like, and answer its questions. The transcript comes after your answers.
listening.wait: The questions come with the recording.
listening.footnote: Not affiliated with INLL. Scripts and questions are not reviewed by a native speaker.
dock.hint_hold: Hold the button or the space bar while you speak, or type below.
dock.placeholder: What you said appears here. You can edit it, or type a message.
dock.listening_title: Hear a short recording and answer its questions
dock.practice_title: Talk about a topic, question by question
dock.review_title: Say again what you have met, from its English
dock.teacher_title: Ask the next message as a grammar question
dock.hint_toggle: Press the button or the space bar, speak, then press again. Or type below.
talk.ready_hold: The microphone is ready. Hold the button and speak.
talk.short_hold: That was too short. Hold the button while you speak.
talk.ready_toggle: The microphone is ready. Press the button and speak.
talk.short_toggle: That was too short. Press the button, speak, then press it again.
status.timings: {word} - last turn: speech-to-text {stt}, tutor {llm}, speech {tts}, total {total}
error.unreachable: The app server is not reachable.
error.not_json: The server sent an answer that is not JSON.
health.no_lod: The dictionary store is not installed: teacher answers cannot be checked against LOD. Run: python scripts/download_lod.py
data.kept: Kept on this PC: {phrases} phrases, {answers} answers ({recordings} recordings), {items} review items, {size}
data.really_delete: This deletes everything the app kept about you on this PC: the learner database and its backups, the saved phrases and every practice recording. It is the last copy. Copies made by a backup or sync tool outside the app are not touched.
review.placeholder: What you said appears here. Change it if it is not what you said, or type it.
practice.placeholder: What you said appears here. Change it if it is not what you said, or type your answer.
mic.blocked: Microphone access is blocked. Allow it for this page in the browser's site settings, or type your message.
mic.missing: No microphone was found. Plug one in, or type your message.
mic.insecure: This page must be opened as http://127.0.0.1 or http://localhost for the microphone to work.
mic.no_recorder: This browser cannot record audio. Type your message.
status.confirm: ready - is that what you said? Edit it if not, then press {button}
status.edit_send: ready - edit the text if you like, then press {button}
practice.pick_topic: Talk about a topic, the way the Sproochentest does. Stop whenever you like.
practice.pick_photo: Pick the picture you would like to talk about.
dispute.label: I think I was right
dispute.noted: Noted - you think you were right. Kept with this answer.
practice.pick_another: That was the whole topic. Fancy another one? Or leave it there for today.
practice.pick_after_stop: We stopped there. Fancy another topic? Or leave it there for today.
lookback.question: Question {n}:
lookback.no_comment: The tutor's comment did not arrive.
lookback.unknown_words: Words I could not find in the dictionary: {list}
status.ready_play: ready - press Play to hear the reply
review.say: ready - say it in Luxembourgish, or type it, then press {button}
review.status_good: ready - Good. Press {next}; if you did not know it, press {override}
review.status_rate: ready - how well did you know it? {again}, {hard}, {good} or {easy}
progress.caption: Corrections per week
listening.title: {genre}: {title}
listening.ready: ready - press Play 1x or Play 0.75x to hear the recording
listening.done: ready - press a turn of the transcript to hear it again
listening.answer: ready - play it again as often as you like, then press Check my answers
listening.chose_wrong: You chose {chosen}: not this one - the answer is {key}
pronunciation.empty: No flagged words yet. Use the flag button under a tutor line to flag a word that was said wrongly.
pronunciation.note: Play speaks the line again with your respelling. Nothing is kept until you press Save.
flag.flagged: Flagged {word}. It is listed in the Pronunciation block.
flag.no_phonemes: none (this voice does not give them)
flag.saved: Saved {word}. The voice uses it from now on.
